Definition: A user-authored private document of acceptability checks, declarations, and formulas run locally over user-supplied data.
Per-check/aggregate status indicating the check is blocked because required inputs are unbound or missing; pass/fail is never reported.
Per-check/aggregate status meaning the user-defined check passed (labeled 'pass').
Per-check/aggregate status meaning the user-defined check failed (labeled 'fail').
Closed-vocabulary basis for a check: user_supplied_rule_pack, owner_design_basis, private_project_basis, invented_non_engineering_example, TBD.
The ordering relation (computed_value <relation> limit_value) of a check; four ordering relations only, no equality.
The eight-field mapping of rule-check conditions to emitted diagnostic codes in a check definition.
A declared input a check consumes, carrying source_kind, quantity_intent, completeness, provenance, and redistribution status.
A declared limit/threshold slot bound into a check, carrying slot_kind, quantity_intent, and value_status.
The rule-pack member that binds required-input and value-slot references and a formula into an acceptability check.
An in-pack reference (library_kind, library_id, record_id, slot_id) resolved backend-side at run time; the private value is never embedded in the pack.
An in-pack reference (result_id) to a solved result row; canonical, supersedes the run-panel selector (DEC-039).
The dimension/unit_ref/unit_required/dimension_check_required block on a declaration carrying const-true relaxation flags.
The DEC-018 SI dual-display catalog backing unit-ref selection, filtered to a binding's dimension.
The aggregate rule-check status computed as the worst of the per-check statuses and lifted to the app envelope.
Closed vocabulary for a required input's source: solver_result, model_input, user_supplied_rule_value, private_library_value, owner_design_basis, TBD.
The notice that rule checks make no code-compliance, certification, sealing, approval, or professional acceptance claim and human review remains required.
